title: Samsung’s leaked Galaxy Z plans for 2027 include an unknown fifth phone
summary: Galaxy Club reports that Samsung is planning to launch five separate Galaxy Z devices in 2027. Previous reports suggest the Galaxy Z Flip 9, Galaxy Z Fold 9, and Galaxy Z Fold 9 Ultra will come as expected releases.
